verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no data-export capability for the xAI API platform, such as a bulk export of conversations, files, collections, or account data in open formats. OpenAI-compatible APIs, Zero Data Retention and the Management API are related features, but none of them is an export-and-leave feature, so none earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
